description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing AI software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build core infrastructure and product features for a software platform, owning work from architecture through deployment while shaping technical direction and the product roadmap alongside company leadership. The role mixes deep engineering, product development and occasional customer-facing work.
 What you'll do
 - Build the core runtime, backend services and distributed systems that power the product.
 - Design mock services and data stores that stand in for third-party tools and internal systems.
 - Create execution, verification, replay and debugging tooling for automated test runs.
 - Connect the product with agent frameworks, model providers and enterprise systems.
 - Work across backend, frontend and cloud infrastructure on a major public cloud provider.
 - Take features from initial design to production release.
 - Support enterprise customers directly when needed.
 - Help set the product roadmap and define how the engineering team grows.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Broad generalist who works with high initiative and needs little direction.
 - Uses AI tools daily as part of regular work.
 - Strong product judgment with clear, well-argued opinions about what to build.
 - Track record of building software through side projects, open source contributions or shipped products.
 - Up to 5 years of experience, with no minimum required.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 220,000 per year
 - Relocation assistance
 - Meals in office
 Location and work model
 - New York City, New York, United States
 - On-site, in person, 5 to 6 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
